items.summary: CME Group just opened 2 altcoins to Wall Street. Both spiked in minutes — but history has a warning for anyone buying this news.

items.title: Is Coinbase's Steadier Side Really A Cushion?
items.summary: Coinbase Global (COIN) wants to be judged as more than a crypto trading venue. Its evidence is subscription and services revenue, the non-trading line the CEO says makes the business a bit more predictable. That line is the metric that should worry a holder. In the first quarter of 2026 it fell 16% quarter-over-quarter, and the stock is down about 39% over the past year even after a summer rebound.

items.title: Not Just Banks: 3 Trading Stocks to Watch After the Fed Rate Hike
items.summary: The Fed raised rates 25 basis points on Sept. 16, and brokers and exchanges like Interactive Brokers, Robinhood, and CME Group stand to benefit from the new hiking cycle.

items.title: CME Group (CME) Debuts New Loan Futures As Metals Trading Hits Records
items.summary: CME Group (NasdaqGS:CME) introduced S&P UBS USD Liquid Leveraged Loan Index futures, adding a new tool for leveraged loan exposure. The contract is based on the S&P UBS USD Liquid Leveraged Loan Index, jointly developed with S&P Dow Jones Indices and UBS. Management highlighted record 24/7 trading activity in gold and silver futures, noting strong retail engagement in precious metals. items.summary: Coinbase just delivered one of its ugliest quarterly reports in years, yet a quiet transformation happening beneath the surface could make the spot trading slump largely irrelevant to its future.

items.title: One Reason the Stakes Are So High for a Rate Increase
items.summary: A lot is on the line for the Fed.  Wall Street is all but certain that the world's most powerful central bank will raise interest rates today.  It would be a shocker, to say the least, if the Fed didn't increase rates amid such high odds.

items.summary: CME is expanding through higher trading volumes, new derivatives products and record market-data revenues while returning capital to shareholders.

items.title: US Stock Futures Rise as Oil Prices Retreat Ahead of Federal Reserve Decision: Dow Jones, S&P, Nasdaq, Wall Street
items.summary: US stock index futures pointed to a higher opening on Wednesday as crude oil prices declined and investors awaited the Federal Reserve’s interest rate decision later in the day. The indicated rebound followed two consecutive sessions of losses that pushed the S&P 500 to its lowest closing level in more than a month.
